facts.fact: ICASA collected R1,287,583,749 for the Universal Service and Access Fund over 2021/22 to 2025/26, R281,177,935 in 2025/26 and R251,411,657 in 2024/25, per the Minister's oral reply to question 763; USAASA administers the spending.

The fund's actual expenditure in 2025/26 was R1,087.904 million against R54.987 million DCDT drawdown and R1,685 million rollover funds, leaving about R652.083 million unspent; both collections and spending are given, the spending figure supplied by USAASA.

The fund's actual expenditure in 2024/25 was R769.092 million against R52.629 million DCDT drawdown and R1,270 million rollover funds, per the Minister's reply; collections for the year were R251.4 million.
